program_name: Master of Science in Children with Special Needs (Challenging Behaviour)

requirements.general_text: Local students A Bachelor’s Degree in Special Needs or related fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 or its equivalent as accepted by the Senate of Perdana University; OR A Bachelor’s Degree in Special Needs or related fields or its equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and not meeting a CGPA of 2.50 as accepted by the Senate of Perdana University; OR Other relevant qualifications approved by the Senate of Perdana University. International students  A Bachelor’s Degree in Special Needs or related fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 or its equivalent as accepted by the Senate of Perdana University; OR A Bachelor’s Degree in Special Needs or related fields or its equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and not meeting a CGPA of 2.50 as accepted by the Senate of Perdana University; OR Other relevant qualifications approved by the Senate of Perdana University. English Language Requirements A minimum IELTS score of 5.5 or equivalent for international students
